title: R4 v3: orchestrator/concurrency.py — adaptive concurrency 0..hard_max from compatible groups (coupled clusters cap their own contribution), capacity and merge pressure, with pinned input shapes (AP P13, P11)
spec:
Why: daemon.dispatch fills wave_limit = min(slots, max_wave or slots) (orchestrator/daemon.py:690), so concurrency is always the hard maximum; AP P13 wants a selected concurrency below the cap derived from evidence, AP P11 wants merge pressure to bound it. v3 after spec reviews T-0569 and T-0589.
What: new pure module orchestrator/concurrency.py; no daemon edits. Tests: this repo runs unittest; every acceptance test id is a `def test_name(self)` method inside a unittest.TestCase subclass in that file; no pytest fixtures.
- reason_kind(reason) -> reason.split(':', 1)[0] (own implementation; do not import interference._reason_kind).
- compatible_groups(ready_ids, pairwise_rows) -> list of lists: connected components over rows with level hard or soft (interference.pairwise shape {a, b, level, reasons}); singletons are independent; deterministic order (sorted by first member).
- group_contribution(group, pairwise_rows) -> int: singleton 1; every internal pair hard -> 1; size >= 3 with any hard edge -> 1; otherwise (soft-only, or size 2 mixed) -> 2. (Under interference.DEFAULT_RULES same_glob/glob_covers are already hard, so no separate shared-interface branch exists; the kind names 'interface' and 'migration' are reserved for a future interference extension and documented as such.)
- select_limit(hard_max, ready_ids, tasks, pairwise_rows, priorities, snapshot=None, pressure=None, durations=None, cfg=None) -> {"hard_max", "limit", "reasons": [str], "tasks_considered": ready_ids, "expected_benefit_s", "groups": [{"members", "contribution"}]}. Input shapes pinned: snapshot = {"executors": {id: {"free": int, ...}}, "claude_workers_free": int, "fallback": bool} (capacity.snapshot); pressure = {"pressure": "none"|"elevated"|"saturated", ...} (merge_pressure.assess); durations = {task_id: seconds}; priorities = {task_id: critical_path.explain dict}. Rules, each appended to reasons when it binds: ready empty -> limit 0, reasons ['no_ready']; start at hard_max ('hard_max=N'); structural bound sum of contributions ('groups=k contributions=m'), a cluster capped to 1 adds 'coupled_group:<sorted ids>'; capacity bound = sum of executor free, or claude_workers_free when fallback ('capacity=m'); pressure saturated -> limit <= max(1, number of singleton groups) ('merge_pressure=saturated'); cfg [scheduler].concurrency_mode 'fixed'|'adaptive' (default adaptive; fixed -> hard_max, reasons ['fixed']); minimum 1 when ready work exists and capacity > 0; never above hard_max.
- expected_benefit_s: selected = the first `limit` ranked ids (ranked by priorities['priority'] descending then id); 0.0 when selected is empty; otherwise sum(est) - max(est) with est from durations or critical_path.est_duration_s(tasks[id]).
- log_row(result, wave_ids=None) -> dict for schedlog.append('concurrency', ...) with hard_max, limit, reasons, tasks_considered, expected_benefit_s, selected, observed_outcome None.
acceptance: tests/test_concurrency.py::test_coupled_cluster_caps_only_its_own_contribution — a hard-coupled cluster of four plus three independent singletons with hard_max 8 yields limit 4 and a coupled_group reason naming the cluster
tests/test_concurrency.py::test_soft_group_contributes_two_and_mixed_cluster_one — two soft-linked tasks contribute 2; three tasks with one hard edge contribute 1
tests/test_concurrency.py::test_independent_modules_select_higher_concurrency — five ready tasks with no interference and hard_max 4 yield limit 4 with the hard_max reason
tests/test_concurrency.py::test_hard_max_is_never_exceeded_and_fixed_mode — twenty independent tasks and hard_max 3 yield limit 3; concurrency_mode fixed returns hard_max with reasons ['fixed']
tests/test_concurrency.py::test_no_ready_work_yields_zero_benefit_zero — empty ready set yields limit 0, reasons ['no_ready'] and expected_benefit_s 0.0 without raising

tests/test_concurrency.py::test_quota_and_merge_pressure_bound_the_limit — a snapshot with two free executor slots bounds the limit to 2 with a capacity reason; pressure saturated with one singleton bounds to 1 with merge_pressure=saturated; log_row carries hard_max, limit, reasons, tasks_considered, expected_benefit_s

constraints.interface_contract: select_limit(hard_max, ready_ids, tasks, pairwise_rows, priorities, snapshot=None, pressure=None, durations=None, cfg=None) -> {hard_max, limit, reasons, tasks_considered, expected_benefit_s, groups}; compatible_groups; group_contribution; reason_kind; snapshot {executors:{id:{free}}, claude_workers_free, fallback}; pressure {pressure: none|elevated|saturated}; config [scheduler].concurrency_mode fixed|adaptive default adaptive; must not import daemon
